blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Dr. Prafulla Chandra Ghosh was the first Chief Minister of West Bengal (1947–1948).
Dr. Bidhan Chandra Roy is regarded as the 'Architect of Modern West Bengal' for establishing key institutions, cities, and plants like Salt Lake, Kalyani, Durgapur Steel Plant, and WBSEB.
Jyoti Basu led the Left Front government for 23 years (1977–2000), spearheading land reforms via Operation Barga and empowering Panchayati Raj.
Mamata Banerjee became West Bengal's first woman Chief Minister in 2011 and launched major social welfare schemes including Kanyashree Prakalpa and Lakshmir Bhandar.
Dr. B.C. Roy is known as the 'Architect of Modern West Bengal', and his birth/death anniversary (July 1) is celebrated as National Doctors' Day.
Operation Barga (land reform scheme) and Panchayati Raj empowerment were major initiatives under Jyoti Basu's 23-year tenure.
Kanyashree Prakalpa scheme won the UN Public Service Award under Mamata Banerjee's administration.
Dr. Prafulla Chandra Ghosh was the first Chief Minister of West Bengal.
